chief_complaint: Pregnancy with hypertension and chronic pain management
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 47-year-old woman who became pregnant on 2022-12-30. Since pregnancy onset she has persistent stage 2 hypertension (SBP 149 / DBP 98) and chronic low‑back pain dating back to 2014, for which she takes ibuprofen and an opioid combination (Percocet). She also has anemia diagnosed in 2010 and prediabetes (A1c 6.1%). Over the past few years she reports increasing stress, social isolation, and limited social contact. A medication review was flagged in March 2020 but remains unresolved. Current antihypertensive therapy is lisinopril, which is contraindicated in pregnancy. She works part‑time, has a criminal record, and has a history of a prior miscarriage.
past_medical_history: Resolved conditions include gingivitis (most recent resolution 2022-04-15), dental filling loss (2019-03-29), two episodes of viral sinusitis (2017-07-12 and 2019-02-01), concussions without loss of consciousness (resolved 2019-04-25), a prior normal pregnancy that ended in miscarriage (resolved 2018-08-10), and a previous stress episode resolved in 2020. These reflect a history of minor dental and infectious issues and past head trauma, but no chronic sequelae.

active_medications.name: Ibuprofen 400 MG Oral Tablet
active_medications.purpose: Pain/inflammation from chronic low back pain

active_medications.name: Acetaminophen 325 MG / Oxycodone Hydrochloride 10 MG Oral Tablet (Percocet)

social_determinants: Part‑time employment, history of criminal record, social isolation, limited social contact, ongoing stress, and higher education. These factors may affect health care access, medication adherence, and overall support during pregnancy.
risk_factor_summary: Blood pressure 149/98 mmHg (stage 2 hypertension), A1c 6.1% (prediabetic), anemia flag present, Charlson comorbidity index 1, clinical complexity moderate. BMI, eGFR, total cholesterol, and LDL are missing. Polypharmacy risk low (3 meds) but medication safety concerns are high due to pregnancy.

data_quality_flags.issue: No documented iron or prenatal vitamin prescription despite anemia and pregnancy
Lisinopril is contraindicated in pregnancy; medication list may be outdated

clinical_impression: A pregnant woman with uncontrolled stage 2 hypertension being treated with a contraindicated ACE inhibitor, chronic low‑back pain managed with NSAIDs and an opioid, anemia, and prediabetes. Psychosocial stressors and limited social support further complicate management. Immediate medication reconciliation and transition to pregnancy‑safe antihypertensives, pain management alternatives, and anemia treatment are indicated.
